fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: You sign in with this name (1–40 characters). No e-mail address needed.
fields.passwordHint: 8 to 128 characters, no other rules. A sentence of several words makes a good password.

errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{time}}.

signIn.title: Sign in to {{productName}}
signIn.stay: You stay signed in on this device until you sign out or don't use it for 30 days.
signIn.throttled: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{time}}.
signIn.throttleHint: The wait doubles with every further failure, up to 15 minutes.

forgot.question: Forgot your password?
forgot.answer: Ask the person who runs this server to reset your password (Administration › Users).
forgot.admin: For the admin account: run this on the server machine and enter the new password:

signIn.signedOutHint: Your other devices stay signed in.
signIn.expired: Your session has expired or was ended. Sign in again to continue where you left off.
signIn.expiredHint: Possible reasons: not used for 30 days, password changed, signed out on another device or ended by an admin.

setup.title: Create admin account
setup.intro: Welcome to {{productName}}. First create the account you use to manage the server. Then add your first library.
setup.localOnly: While no account exists, this page can only be reached from devices in the same network as the server. There are no default credentials.
setup.recover: Forget the password later? This command on the server machine resets it and signs out all devices of the account:
setup.recoverWhere: Docker: via {{dockerCommand}}. Synology: over SSH on the DiskStation.

remote.title: Setup only from the local network
remote.body: This {{productName}} server is not set up yet. So that nobody on the internet can take it over, the first admin account can only be created from a device in the same network as the server.
remote.step1: Connect your device to the network the server is in (Wi-Fi or cable).
remote.step2: Open the server's local address there, for example http://192.168.1.10:8460.
remote.step3: Create the admin account. You set up remote access later in Administration.
remote.still: This connection still does not come from the local network.

profiles.title: Choose a profile
profiles.placeholder: Choosing a profile is not available in this version yet. Sign out and sign in with an account without managed profiles or PIN.

signOut.failed: Signing out did not work. Please try again.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.note: Your other devices are signed out afterwards. This device stays signed in.
changePassword.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
